turns: I need a feel-good comedy for a rainy Sunday
results.reply:
These five picks all score high on comedy, and most also score well on feel-good, so they suit a cozy rainy Sunday. Forgetting Sarah Marshall is the weakest of the five on feel-good, at 78%.

**The Wedding Singer** — Feel-good 97%, comedy 96%, funny 90%. Wedding singer Robbie Hart, preparing to marry Linda in 1985 New Jersey, befriends new waitress Julia Sullivan at the reception hall.
**Groundhog Day** — Comedy 97%, feel-good 88%, funny 81%. Cynical TV weatherman Phil Connors is sent to Pittsburgh for February 1 with producer Rita Hanson and cameraman Larry.
**Little Miss Sunshine** — Feel-good 92%, comedy 91%, funny 81%. Stressed mother Sheryl Hoover lives in Albuquerque with her husband Richard, an aspiring motivational speaker, and her teenage son Dwayne.
**Crazy, Stupid, Love.** — Comedy 94%, feel-good 92%, funny 81%. Cal Weaver is a middle-aged family man whose wife Emily asks for a divorce after revealing an affair.
**Forgetting Sarah Marshall** — Comedy 98%, funny 91%, feel-good 78%. Composer Peter Bretter, dumped by his girlfriend Sarah Marshall, travels to Oahu, Hawaii, to get over her.

judge.reason: All five are well-loved comedies with warm, uplifting tones (The Wedding Singer and Groundhog Day especially), ideal for a cozy rainy Sunday, though Little Miss Sunshine and Forgetting Sarah Marshall have slightly more bittersweet or raunchy edges.

judge.reason: Every film is a well-known psychological mind-bender, and most are famous for big twist endings (Shutter Island, Fight Club, The Machinist, Memento), with Donnie Darko adding a puzzling, reality-bending finale.
